answer: Seed the grading queue with planted canary tasks whose correct scores are already known. A sybil ring that rubber-stamps its own clones will also rubber-stamp a planted dud, say a reply claiming a violet pearl was found on a desert island with no oil, and every grader who rates that nonsense highly is flagged. Flagged graders lose their seats and their pending rewards, so a ring that coordinates scores exposes itself quickly, while honest graders who judge each answer on its merits pass untouched.
